SELECT H.ID, H.ROOM_ID, H.EMPLOYEE_ID, H.STATUS, H.REQUESTED_AT, H.STARTED_AT, H.COMPLETED_AT, H.INSPECTED_AT, H.NOTE, R.ROOM_NUM, R.FLOOR, RT.NAME AS TYPE_NAME, E.NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM HOUSEKEEPING H JOIN ROOM R ON H.ROOM_ID = R.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID
LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON H.EMPLOYEE_ID = E.ID
AND R.FLOOR = #{floor} AND H.STATUS = #{status} AND E.NAME = #{employeeName}
ORDER BY H.REQUESTED_AT DESC

SELECT H.ID, H.ROOM_ID, H.EMPLOYEE_ID, H.STATUS, H.REQUESTED_AT, H.STARTED_AT, H.COMPLETED_AT, H.INSPECTED_AT, H.NOTE, R.ROOM_NUM, R.FLOOR, RT.NAME AS TYPE_NAME, E.NAME AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM HOUSEKEEPING H JOIN ROOM R ON H.ROOM_ID = R.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE E ON H.EMPLOYEE_ID = E.ID WHERE H.ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE HOUSEKEEPING SET EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId} WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE HOUSEKEEPING SET STATUS = '청소중', STARTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE HOUSEKEEPING SET COMPLETED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE HOUSEKEEPING SET STATUS = '점검완료', INSPECTED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE HOUSEKEEPING SET NOTE = #{note} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM HOUSEKEEPING GROUP BY STATUS
